title: Overseer Bias Propagation Chain: Mapping How Human Cognitive Bias Travels Into Model Behavior

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: mapping the full causal path from overseer bias to model behavior is foundational. Knowing which step has the most leverage directly enables targeted interventions. Every link in the theory is explicit.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Instrumenting the full training pipeline (bias measurement in labels, model learning dynamics, inference behavior, comparison to original bias) is a multi-component system. Beginners would struggle to set up each measurement stage and connect them coherently within the time budget.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Four measurement stages across the full pipeline is too broad for 30 hours. Each stage is essentially a separate experiment. No clear single deliverable that can stand alone.
